source: docs/champions/style.md, Diagnostics: guide values, never gates (design.md, Judgment over rules), from the archived neon look's rules (docs/archive/design/neon-look-thresholds.json, calibrated by ps-wnj.21-31) for its one edge look, plus monster white; readability and the hero's margin judge the lines (ps-6y2.13); the frame's and each type's black share gone with the edge cuts (ps-6y2.41)

floor_p90_max.why: rings included, the floor stays under ground light

floor_p99_max.why: the grid's lines are a quiet background (ps-wnj.24); a downbeat's ring never lifts the floor above ground light

background_light_max.why: the world never drowns the swarm: the background carries a small share of the frame's light (ps-wnj.24)

frame_p25_max.why: the floor's fallback on a frame without an ID pass: the darkest quarter is void

bright_share_max.why: light comes from things, not a lit world

bright_share_min.why: something emits; a staged sparse still (a duel on cleared ground) is judged by its hero margin and readability instead (ps-wnj.29)

clipped_max.why: clipped white only for impact frames and the blade's core

clipped_impact_max.why: even a special moment never whites out the frame

clipped_blob_max.why: no blown-out region outside impact frames

white_max.why: white is the hero's: its lines, blade and effects, a small share of any frame

monster_white_max.why: white is the hero's: a monster's lines never whiten, even where they cross under bloom (uncalibrated: the look pass, ps-6y2.23, sets it on the real crowd)

halo_impact_min.why: emitters glow at a special moment (ps-wnj.19); steady frames are calm

families_max.why: the hue budget: at most four families plus white in a frame

key60_min.why: each frame has a colour key

key60_median_min.why: a set keys as Geometry Wars 3 does

palette_conformance_min.why: everything drawn takes its colour from a role

shot_floor_range_max.why: one world across the shots, not stitched parts

flash_frames_max.why: flashes are for special moments: at most half the steady stills hold a near-white region over 0.3% of the frame (ps-wnj.24)

hero_margin_min.why: no monster is ever brighter than the hero: the hero's lines over the monsters'

monster_form_min.why: a monster is lit lines over a dark body, not flat paint

swarm_separation_min.why: a dense clump of one type reads as individuals, not a blob (fewer than four dense tiles are no clump)

readability_min.why: monsters' lines stand off the ground round them (TD15)
